headline: KCR @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is KCR 5.13 at WSN 5.28, with a projected total of 10.41. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: KCR moved +0.98 runs while WSN moved +1.29, changing the projected margin by -0.32 runs. The projected total climbed +2.33, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -16.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Zack Littell has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for James Wood, Carter Jensen, Bobby Witt Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags John Rave because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
